summary.text: Bobbie Shields is the Republican candidate for the North Carolina State Senate, District 40, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Joyce Waddell (D).
Shields is a civil engineer who has run against Waddell in the general election in 2018, 2020 and 2022.

paragraphs.text: Bobbie Shields earned a bachelor's degree from NC State University in 1975, and his career experience includes working as a civil engineer, according to Ballotpedia.
Shields was the Republican nominee for District 40 in 2018, 2020 and 2022, and incumbent Joyce Waddell defeated him in each general election.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Shields listed three campaign messages: economic development, which he described as drawing on his experience attracting and retaining jobs and capital investments; supporting teachers and providing a rigorous education; and well-maintained infrastructure, citing his background as a licensed engineer.
